pwsbuilder August 27, 2017

Ellen Cuddy and Doris Mee held a free demonstration on Saturday, August 26 from 2 to 4 pm at The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists.

The Art Gallery of The Guild of Harwich Artists (source page unavailable), 551 Main Street (Route 28), Harwich Port, is open 7-days a week. The Art Gallery exhibits original artwork by 24 local artists. Free public parking located across the street at the Tourist Information Center of the Harwich Chamber of Commerce.
